units.source_text: 周围很暗，沙子到哪里都是重复着不规则的蜿蜒曲折。

en.t: It was dark all around, and everywhere the sand repeated its irregular twists and turns.

units.source_text: 蜿蜒曲折中还有曲折，由几处更细小的起伏分割开来。

en.t: Within those twists were still more bends, divided here and there by smaller undulations.

units.source_text: 既定目标那村落里的灯光，被蜿蜒无尽的连峰遮住了，进入不了视野。

en.t: The lights of the village he had set as his destination were hidden by the endlessly winding chain of ridges and could not be seen.

units.source_text: 这时只能凭直觉，一边修正方向一边前进，可老是出现令人愕然的误差。

en.t: At this point he could only rely on instinct, correcting his direction as he moved forward, yet astonishing errors kept appearing.

units.source_text: 恐怕无意识中一直追求着亮光，所以，才跑到高处来了吧。

en.t: Most likely, he had been unconsciously seeking the light all along, and that was why he had climbed up to higher ground.
